changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to consistent format, removed redundant 'Llama-3 8B (instruct)', simplified output descriptions, and added grounded captions as distinct output type.
Simplified metric variants to base form (CHAIR-MEN and CHAIR i are variants of CHAIR). Removed redundant metrics and normalized naming conventions.
Removed vague model specifications since no specific LLMs are used as judges (only for fact extraction as part of FaithScore metric). Kept only the core method description and criteria.
Paper explicitly states reliance on automatic metrics and contains no human evaluation. Removed placeholder 'None' values.

overall_notes: The paper conducts a thorough evaluation of LVLM hallucination using automatic metrics but relies entirely on automatic evaluation (no human evaluation). The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent naming. The paper focuses on image captioning with grounding objectives and evaluates using both standard captioning metrics (CHAIR, FaithScore, CIDEr, CLIP-Score) and QA-based hallucination detection (POPE).
